mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_settings(user_id,checkin_enabled,checkin_frequency,daily_time, plan_due_enabled,report_enabled,data_change_enabled,import_failed_enabled) VALUES(#{userId},#{settings.checkinEnabled},#{settings.checkinFrequency},#{settings.dailyTime}, #{settings.planDueEnabled},#{settings.reportEnabled},#{settings.dataChangeEnabled},#{settings.importFailedEnabled}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE checkin_enabled=#{settings.checkinEnabled},checkin_frequency=#{settings.checkinFrequency}, daily_time=#{settings.dailyTime},plan_due_enabled=#{settings.planDueEnabled},report_enabled=#{settings.reportEnabled}, data_change_enabled=#{settings.dataChangeEnabled},import_failed_enabled=#{settings.importFailedEnabled}
mapper.select: SELECT id,kind,title,body,target,data_cutoff,created_at,read_at FROM notifications WHERE ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET read_at=COALESCE(read_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id=#{id}
UPDATE notifications SET read_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND read_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.timezone FROM profiles p JOIN users u ON u.id=p.user_id AND u.enabled=TRUE JOIN notification_settings s ON s.user_id=p.user_id JOIN system_settings g ON g.id=1 WHERE (s.checkin_enabled AND g.checkin_enabled) OR (s.plan_due_enabled AND g.plan_due_enabled) OR (s.data_change_enabled AND g.data_change_enabled)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications(user_id,kind,event_key,title,body,target,data_cutoff) SELECT candidate.* FROM ( SELECT p.user_id,'CHECKIN' AS kind,CONCAT('task:',i.id) AS event_key,'计划打卡提醒' AS title, CONCAT('任务「',i.title,'」等待打卡。') AS body,CONCAT('/plans?id=',p.id) AS target,NULL AS data_cutoff FROM notification_settings s JOIN profiles f ON f.user_id=s.user_id AND f.timezone=#{zone} JOIN users u ON u.id=s.user_id AND u.enabled=TRUE JOIN system_settings g ON g.id=1 JOIN plans p ON p.user_id=s.user_id AND p.status='ACTIVE' JOIN plan_items i ON i.plan_id=p.id AND i.retired=FALSE AND i.date=DATE(#{localNow}) LEFT JOIN checkins c ON c.item_id=i.id AND c.date=i.date WHERE g.checkin_enabled AND s.checkin_enabled AND s.checkin_frequency='PER_TASK' AND c.id IS NULL AND COALESCE(i.reminder_time,i.time) <= TIME(#{localNow}) UNION ALL SELECT s.user_id,'CHECKIN',CONCAT('daily:',DATE(#{localNow})),'每日打卡提醒', '今天还有计划任务等待打卡。','/plans',NULL FROM notification_settings s JOIN profiles f ON f.user_id=s.user_id AND f.timezone=#{zone} JOIN users u ON u.id=s.user_id AND u.enabled=TRUE JOIN system_settings g ON g.id=1 WHERE g.checkin_enabled AND s.checkin_enabled AND s.checkin_frequency='DAILY' AND s.daily_time <= TIME(#{localNow}) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM plans p JOIN plan_items i ON i.plan_id=p.id LEFT JOIN checkins c ON c.item_id=i.id AND c.date=i.date WHERE p.user_id=s.user_id AND p.status='ACTIVE' AND i.retired=FALSE AND i.date=DATE(#{localNow}) AND c.id IS NULL ) UNION ALL SELECT p.user_id,'PLAN_DUE',CONCAT('plan:',p.id,':',p.end_date),'计划今日到期', CONCAT('计划「',p.title,'」将于今天结束。'),CONCAT('/plans?id=',p.id),NULL FROM notification_settings s JOIN profiles f ON f.user_id=s.user_id AND f.timezone=#{zone} JOIN users u ON u.id=s.user_id AND u.enabled=TRUE JOIN system_settings g ON g.id=1 JOIN plans p ON p.user_id=s.user_id AND p.status='ACTIVE' AND p.end_date=DATE(#{localNow}) WHERE g.plan_due_enabled AND s.plan_due_enabled UNION ALL SELECT observed.user_id,'DATA_CHANGE',CONCAT('weight:',observed.id,':',observed.previous_id), '体重记录有变化','同一来源的最近两条体重记录数值不同。', '/weight',observed.measured_at FROM ( SELECT w.user_id,w.id,w.measured_at,w.weight_kg, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY w.user_id,w.source_name ORDER BY w.measured_at DESC,w.id DESC) AS position_no, LEAD(w.id) OVER(PARTITION BY w.user_id,w.source_name ORDER BY w.measured_at DESC,w.id DESC) AS previous_id, LEAD(w.weight_kg) OVER(PARTITION BY w.user_id,w.source_name ORDER BY w.measured_at DESC,w.id DESC) AS previous_weight FROM notification_settings s JOIN profiles f ON f.user_id=s.user_id AND f.timezone=#{zone} JOIN users u ON u.id=s.user_id AND u.enabled=TRUE JOIN system_settings g ON g.id=1 JOIN weight_records w ON w.user_id=s.user_id WHERE g.data_change_enabled AND s.data_change_enabled AND w.measured_at <= #{localNow} ) observed WHERE observed.position_no=1 AND DATE(observed.measured_at)=DATE(#{localNow}) AND observed.weight_kg <> observed.previous_weight ) candidate LEFT JOIN notifications existing ON existing.user_id=candidate.user_id AND existing.kind=candidate.kind AND existing.event_key=candidate.event_key WHERE existing.id IS NULL ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=notifications.id

INSERT INTO notifications(user_id,kind,event_key,title,body,target) SELECT s.user_id,'REPORT',CAST(#{reportId} AS CHAR),'健康报告已生成', '可以查看本次生成的健康报告。',CONCAT('/reports?id=',#{reportId}) FROM notification_settings s JOIN system_settings g ON g.id=1 WHERE s.user_id=#{userId} AND s.report_enabled AND g.report_enabled ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=notifications.id

INSERT INTO notifications(user_id,kind,event_key,title,body,target) SELECT s.user_id,'IMPORT_FAILED',CONCAT(IF(#{steps},'steps:','sleep:'),#{batchId}), IF(#{valid}=0,'导入失败','导入发现失败行'), CONCAT('批次中有 ',#{invalid},' 行校验失败或暂不支持。'), IF(#{steps},'/activity#step-import','/records#sleep-import') FROM notification_settings s JOIN system_settings g ON g.id=1 WHERE s.user_id=#{userId} AND s.import_failed_enabled AND g.import_failed_enabled ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=notifications.id

INSERT INTO notifications(user_id,kind,event_key,title,body,target) SELECT s.user_id,'IMPORT_FAILED',CONCAT('request:',UUID()),'导入失败', '文件未能完成预览，请检查文件格式和导入参数后重新选择。', IF(#{steps},'/activity#step-import','/records#sleep-import') FROM notification_settings s JOIN system_settings g ON g.id=1 WHERE s.user_id=#{userId} AND s.import_failed_enabled AND g.import_failed_enabled
